_meta.purpose: Locked parameter database for the HIERARCHICAL SCALE-RENORMALIZATION interpreter. Every entry is an INDEPENDENTLY measured/published value, a UNIVERSAL law/theorem, or a documented modelling choice -- NEVER a value chosen by us to match a biological modulus, a tissue size, or an organ stiffness. The renormalization operator reads ONLY this DB for physical constants; it never reads any validation target when computing a flow. This is the difference between a LOCKED measured input [L] and a back-fit.

grades.[L]: locked: independently measured/published value, universal law, or exact theorem, cited; legitimate to use
grades.[V]: verified: an EXACT closed form / theorem evaluated here to machine precision (precision, NOT a measurement match)
grades.[F]: fixed modelling choice (functional form / generic central value of a cited range); documented
grades.[O]: open: the entity-specific MEASURED value does not exist in literature accessible here; a generic placeholder stands in and the residual is declared open

_meta.rule: UNIVERSAL or CITED-MEASURED or EXACT-THEOREM => not a violation. PER-TARGET-TUNED => forbidden. No entry below was tuned to a biological target.
_meta.non_fit_invariant: hierarchy.gate asserts the operator produces identical flow whether or not any target table is present (constants are target-independent).

jamming._axis: RIGIDITY EMERGENCE (cells gather -> stiffness) -- the universal physics of how a packing of soft units acquires a bulk/shear modulus at a critical packing fraction. The SAME jamming physics the VP core thesis applies to the vacuum, applied one level up to a packing of biological units.

phi_c_3d_frictionless.provenance: Onset-of-jamming packing fraction phi_c for 3D frictionless spheres ~ random close packing ~0.639: O'Hern, Silbert, Liu & Nagel 2003, Phys. Rev. E 68:011306 ('Jamming at zero T and zero applied stress'). At phi_c the bulk AND shear moduli simultaneously become non-zero. Bernal 1960 / Scott & Kilgour 1969 give RCP~0.6366. FRICTION and POLYDISPERSITY shift phi_c down (frictional ~0.55-0.58) -- which is exactly why the ABSOLUTE biological value is graded [O], not this universal anchor.

spatial_dimension_d.provenance: Physical space dimension d=3. Enters the isostatic coordination z_iso = 2d.

z_isostatic_3d.provenance: Maxwell isostatic coordination z_iso = 2d = 6 in 3D (Maxwell 1864 counting argument; exact). At the jamming point the packing is marginally rigid with z = z_iso (O'Hern et al. 2003).

coordination_onset_exponent.provenance: Excess coordination above isostatic scales as Delta_z = z - z_iso ~ (phi - phi_c)^(1/2): O'Hern et al. 2003 PRE 68:011306 (Eq. 6 / Fig. 9), confirmed across potentials, polydispersity, and dimension. Universal exponent 1/2; not fitted.

rigidity_coordination_linearity.provenance: The rigidity that emerges CONTINUOUSLY at the transition (the shear modulus, which vanishes at phi_c) is set by the excess connectivity above isostaticity: G ~ Delta_z (linear in excess contacts): Wyart, Nagel & Witten 2005 EPL 72:486; Liu & Nagel 2010 Annu. Rev. Condens. Matter Phys. 1:347. Composing with Delta_z ~ (phi-phi_c)^(1/2) gives the continuous rigidity onset ~ (phi-phi_c)^(1/2).

rg_scale_invariance.provenance: The jamming transition exhibits EMERGENT SCALE INVARIANCE and admits a renormalization-group / Widom scaling description: Goodrich, Liu & Sethna 2016, PNAS 113:9745 ('Scaling ansatz for the jamming transition'). This grounds the use of a renormalization LADDER (repeated coarse-graining) for an aggregate of jammed units.

biological_tissue_rigidity_transition.provenance: Living tissues undergo a jamming/rigidity (fluid->solid) transition controlled by cell connectivity/shape: Bi, Lopez, Schwarz & Manning 2015, Nat. Phys. 11:1074 ('A density-independent rigidity transition in biological tissues'); van Hecke 2010, J. Phys. Condens. Matter 22:033101 (review). Grounds applying the jamming operator to a packing of CELLS, not only of inert grains.

composite_bounds._axis: EXACT ELASTIC-MIXTURE THEOREMS -- the rigorous upper/lower bounds the effective modulus of any packing must lie between. These are mathematical theorems, evaluated here exactly (graded [V]); they are NOT fitted and carry no free parameter.

voigt_isostrain_upper.form: B_Voigt = sum_i phi_i * B_i  (volume-weighted arithmetic mean); with a void phase B_void=0 -> B_Voigt = phi * B_unit
voigt_isostrain_upper.provenance: Voigt 1889 isostrain (uniform-strain) bound -- the rigorous UPPER bound on the effective modulus of a composite. Exact theorem.

reuss_isostress_lower.form: 1/B_Reuss = sum_i phi_i / B_i  (volume-weighted harmonic mean); with a void phase B_void=0 -> B_Reuss = 0
reuss_isostress_lower.provenance: Reuss 1929 isostress (uniform-stress) bound -- the rigorous LOWER bound. With any void in series the bound is 0, i.e. an UNJAMMED packing has no rigidity. Exact theorem.

hierarchy_scales._axis: THE BIOLOGICAL LADDER -- characteristic length scales of the structural levels the renormalization climbs. GENERIC central values (textbook orders of magnitude); they vary by cell/tissue/organ type, so they are graded [F] and used ONLY to count units-per-rung (volume ratio). NEVER fitted to a target. The flow's DIMENSIONLESS content (the rigidity fraction J, the wave-speed softening ratio) does not depend on these numbers at all.

rungs.name: molecular / chromatin
rungs.provenance: Nucleosome core particle ~11 nm disc (Luger et al. 1997, Nature 389:251); DNA base-step rise 0.34 nm. The cell-level gamma (mean NN stacking dG) lives at this scale -- the stiffness of the genome polymer.

rungs.name: cell
rungs.provenance: Typical animal cell diameter ~10-20 um (Alberts, Molecular Biology of the Cell). Generic central value.

rungs.name: tissue (functional unit)
rungs.provenance: Functional tissue unit / acinus / lobule scale ~0.1-1 mm. Generic central value. This is where the morphogen LEVEL/SHAPE (Appendix B) lives.

rungs.name: organ
rungs.provenance: Organ scale ~ cm. Generic central value.

rungs.name: organ system / body
rungs.provenance: Organ-system / whole-body scale ~ 0.1-1 m. Generic central value.

unit_mechanics._axis: THE [O] ENTRY POINT -- the absolute mechanical properties of a single base unit. These are the ONLY quantities that set absolute magnitude, and they are exactly the unmeasured biological specifics. Generic placeholders stand in; the absolute flow is declared [O]. The DIMENSIONLESS flow (ratios, J, c-softening per rung) is INDEPENDENT of these and carries the [V]/[L] content.

single_cell_bulk_modulus_pa.provenance: [O] Single-cell elastic modulus E ~ 0.1-10 kPa varies by cell type and method (AFM nanoindentation, optical-tweezer/optical-stretcher, micropipette aspiration): Hochmuth 2000 J. Biomech. 33:15; Guck et al. 2005 Biophys. J. 88:3689. A generic 1 kPa central placeholder stands in; the per-cell-type MEASURED modulus is the named obstacle. Absolute B-flow is [O].

single_cell_density_kg_per_m3.provenance: Mammalian cell mass density ~1.03-1.10 g/mL (slightly denser than water): e.g. Grover et al. 2011 PNAS 108:10992 (suspended microchannel resonator). Generic central value; used only as the density anchor of the ladder. The DIMENSIONLESS softening ratio does not depend on it.

_open._axis: [O] data-blocked specifics (NOT in this DB; declared open, generic placeholders used)
_open.per_scale_modulus_atlas: [O] measured bulk/shear moduli at each biological level (cell -> tissue -> organ) by elastography (MRE/USE), AFM, micro-rheology -> generic placeholders + universal jamming flow stand in
_open.per_rung_packing_fraction: [O] measured cell packing fraction phi at each level (confocal/EM stereology) -> a documented phi profile stands in; the operator is general in phi
_open.ecm_stiffening: [O] per-tissue extracellular-matrix / mineralization contribution that can RAISE the intrinsic unit modulus above the cell value (e.g. cartilage, bone) -> not modelled; flagged as why real flow need not be monotone
